member.name: T:Roblox.Platform.Presence.IPresenceReader
member.summary: Provides methods to read presence-related data.
member.remarks:
It is notable that his interface has a rather unique approach to handle service failures: If _any_ service-level failure occurs, then the failure is logged and the _default_ result is returned. This means that the consumer can not differentiate between the "user has not been online recently" and the "the presence service is down" case.
This behaviour was inherited from the IPresenceRegistrar implementation and changing it will require auditing and updating all consumers to handle errors gracefully.
